subject: people
objective: Which option gives more effect per unit of cost?
instruction: A business is preparing a people & organisation analysis. The question is: Which option gives more effect per unit of cost. The tile covers Compare a people programme with a declared alternative on cost per unit of effect, with the effect you declare. The declared figures are: options row 1: name basic, cost 10000, effect 40; row 2: name intensive, cost 18000, effect 60. Use people programme cost-effectiveness in a competitive market and industry context, and report the method's result.
